subject: APAC subprocessor inventory & residency addendum
messages:
From: Selena Cho <security@acmepayments.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC subprocessor detail request for DPA review

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — we’re working through the DPA review for an upcoming pilot in Singapore and need a bit more granularity on Redwood’s subprocessor footprint for APAC customers. Could you provide the latest inventory that includes at minimum:

- Processor name and primary role (e.g., logging, analytics, CDN, KMS)
- Countries where data is processed or stored (APAC focus)
- Whether the vendor has access to plaintext request/response logs
- Encryption/KMS details and whether an HSM is used
- Any subcontractors (i.e., who the processor uses downstream)

If possible, we prefer a CSV we can ingest into our vendor tracker. Also flag any subprocessors that are newly added or planned changes in the next 60 days — that’s a gating item for our legal team.

Cc’ing our legal contact Marcus for visibility. Thanks — can you get this to us by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Selena
Security Operations, Acme Payments
[signature]
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Selena Cho <security@acmepayments.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC subprocessor detail request for DPA review

Hi Selena — thanks for the note. Attaching a scoped inventory CSV for APAC-relevant subprocessors; it contains the fields you requested plus a short "notes" column for planned changes. Quick highlights inline:

- CDN: EdgeWave (primary APAC PoPs in SG, JP) — no plaintext log access; retains aggregated metrics only.
- Observability: LogStream (proc in SG, US) — encrypted at rest; access limited to SREs for Pager duty (no downstream access).
- Caching/edge: CacheVelocity (proc in SG, AU) — may be used as a temporary passthrough; we are not exporting logs to third parties.
- KMS/HSM: We use KeyVaultCo for customer key management by default (HSM-backed in EU/US). For APAC pilot we can provide regionally scoped keys via Dedicated/Private deployments.

A few notes on changes: we have a planned switch from "TempInsights" -> "Observify" for observability in Q3; that is flagged in the CSV.

Attachment: [Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_APAC_20260714.csv (CSV, 48KB)]

I’ve looped in Rishi for the KMS/HSM specifics and export-control considerations. If you want a short call to walk through the CSV, happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, Selena Cho <security@acmepayments.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC subprocessor detail request for DPA review

Hi all — quick technical follow-up on the inventory Jasmine shared:

- KeyVaultCo: HSM-backed keys in US/EU. For APAC residency we can (1) use our Dedicated deployment with customer-managed keys in an APAC KMS, or (2) configure cross-region KeyVaultCo instances under a separate key policy.
- Export controls: none of the listed subprocessors perform additional cross-border analytics on plaintext customer data. Any telemetry that leaves a region is aggregated and hashed; we do not ship raw user payloads to external analytics partners.
- Access: only SRE/admin roles at specific subprocessors have time-bound access to logs; we maintain audit logs and can provide scoped slices for audit requests.

Drive folder with supporting attestations: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3ExampleSubprocessorDocs

If Acme requires HSM within SG specifically, we’ll need procurement to approve a Private/Dedicated deployment addendum (see Laura’s note below). Tech-wise we can support region-locked keys and retention controls.

—Rishi
Principal Infra Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Tan <legal@acmepayments.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Selena Cho <security@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC subprocessor detail request for DPA review

Thanks Jasmine and Rishi — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from legal:

1) For the pilot we need confirmation that request/response logs for Singapore tenants can be retained within APAC for 90 days and not replicated to US storage.
2) If there’s any downstream subcontractor that performs re-processing outside APAC, we need that explicitly flagged and an option to opt-out.

Would you be able to provide a clean confirmation and a draft addendum we can start reviewing? If Redwood can provide a regional logging option (even if behind Dedicated capacity) and a short addendum, we can proceed to countersign quickly.

Regards,
Marcus Tan
Senior Counsel, Acme Payments
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Tan <legal@acmepayments.com>, Selena Cho <security@acmepayments.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC subprocessor detail request for DPA review

Marcus / Selena — appreciate the clear asks. Short answers and next steps:

- Regional logs: yes, we can ensure Singapore-tenant request/response logs are retained in APAC for the 90-day window and not replicated to US storage, provided the account is configured on a Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Downstream repro: any processor that performs re-processing outside APAC is flagged in the attached draft addendum; our standard option is an opt-out clause for that specific processor.

I’m attaching a draft APAC data residency addendum (procurement/legal draft) for your review. Procurement will need to sign it and we’ll need a brief SOW to enable Dedicated capacity for the pilot. Proposed next step: 30-min call tomorrow to align on the addendum details and timeline.
